page.overview:
Who is Kaikias?

Kaikias was the Greek god of the northeast wind, he is one of the lesser known wind gods annd the best image of him is on The Tower of the Winds in Athens.

He is shown as a bearded man with a shield full of hail-stones

The Roman spelling of Kaikias was Caecius his name is cognate to the Latin word caecus "blind", that is, he was seen as a "dark" wind. Category:Anemoi Category:Nature Gods Category:Sky Gods Category:Directional Gods Category:Personification
